# Resource (hush_notification_configuration)

Notification configuration resource for managing Hush Security notification configurations. With config_id it manages a predefined configuration; without it, it creates one, such as an activity stream (trigger agw_activity). An imported configuration is disabled on destroy, not deleted; a predefined one is adopted with config_id and needs no import.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a predefined notification configuration
data "hush_notification_configuration" "digest" {
  trigger = "nhi_digest"
}

# Create notification channel
resource "hush_notification_channel" "email_alerts" {
  name        = "security-email"
  description = "Email notifications for security alerts"
  enabled     = true

  email_config {
    address = "security@example.com"
  }
}

# Manage a predefined configuration: config_id, then what it may change
resource "hush_notification_configuration" "alerts" {
  config_id   = data.hush_notification_configuration.digest.id
  enabled     = true
  aggregation = "week"

  channel_ids = [
    hush_notification_channel.email_alerts.id
  ]
}

output "notification_configuration" {
  value = hush_notification_configuration.alerts
}

# Without config_id the resource creates the configuration: here, the agent
# gateway's activity log streamed to Datadog Logs from one deployment.
resource "hush_notification_channel" "datadog" {
  name = "datadog-logs"

  datadog_config {
    site               = "datadoghq.eu"
    api_key_wo         = var.datadog_api_key
    api_key_wo_version = "1"
  }
}

resource "hush_notification_configuration" "activity" {
  name        = "gateway-activity"
  trigger     = "agw_activity"
  enabled     = true
  channel_ids = [hush_notification_channel.datadog.id]

  dispatch_filters {
    name   = "deployment"
    op     = "eq"
    values = ["dep-abcdefghijk"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `aggregation` (String) How notifications are grouped: short, day, week, month, or stream for an activity stream. Set only where the trigger takes one: certificate_expiring (day or week) and nhi_digest (day, week or month); the others are fixed.
- `channel_ids` (List of String) The list of notification channel IDs to send notifications to
- `config_id` (String) The ID of a predefined notification configuration to manage. Without it, the resource creates one from name and trigger.
- `description` (String) The description of the notification configuration
- `dispatch_filters` (Block List) Filters narrowing what is sent. Which names a trigger takes is the API's to check. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--dispatch_filters))
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the notification configuration is enabled
- `name` (String) The name of the notification configuration. Required without config_id.
- `trigger` (String) What the notifications are about. Required without config_id; changing it creates a new configuration.

### Read-Only

- `created` (Boolean) Whether this resource created the configuration. Only then does destroy delete it; otherwise, as for a predefined or imported one, destroy disables it and clears its channels.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the notification configuration
- `last_triggered_at` (String) The last trigger timestamp of the notification configuration
- `status` (String) ok, warning, error or disabled: whether what it selected can be delivered to
- `status_message` (String) Why the status is not ok, when it is not

<a id="nestedblock--dispatch_filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dispatch_filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) severity, env_type, notification_type, expires_in_days or deployment
- `op` (String) eq or neq; gte or lte for expires_in_days
- `values` (List of String) The values to match. expires_in_days takes one number of days.
